name: path_traversal_download
title: Download an export by name
body: The exports page lists files; this lets people download one.
diff:
### api/exports.py (modified, +8/-0)
@@ -10,3 +10,11 @@
 @router.get("/exports")
 def list_exports():
     return sorted(os.listdir(EXPORT_DIR))
+
+
+@router.get("/exports/{name}")
+def download_export(name: str):
+    path = os.path.join(EXPORT_DIR, name)
+    if not os.path.isfile(path):
+        raise HTTPException(status_code=404)
+    return FileResponse(path)

defects.what: name is joined unchecked; an encoded ../ (or an absolute path) reads any file on the host
